en.t: I still cannot do anything like that now.

units.source_text: 因此我想要拜您为师，学习成仙之术。

en.t: So I wish to take you as my teacher and learn the art of becoming an immortal.
No, you do not need to hide it from me.

units.source_text: 您一定是个法力高强的神仙吧？

en.t: You must be an immortal with great magical power, must you not?

units.source_text: 如果不是神仙，怎么可能在一夜之间让我成为数一数二的大财主呢。

en.t: If you were not an immortal, how could you have made me one of the greatest rich men in a single night?

units.source_text: 我诚恳的请求您收下我，做我的师傅，教我学习仙术吧。”

en.t: I sincerely beg you to accept me, become my teacher, and teach me the arts of immortality."
